leagues.name: Bangladesh Football League
leagues.note: 10 clubs compete in the 2025-26 season (this competition, formerly the Bangladesh Premier League, was rebranded the Bangladesh Football League); only these 4 were confirmed by name in available search snippets (champions Bashundhara Kings, plus Rahmatganj MFS, Fortis FC, Dhaka Abahani). Remaining ~6 clubs could not be verified this session.
